bias.zh: 下行趋势 · 反弹受阻于 $190 下方

read.en: Nvidia rose 2.8% on Nov 6 to $186.64, trading $185.22–194.90 on volume about 1.6 times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($195.4), 10-day ($204.5), 30-day ($218.5) and 100-day ($214.0) averages and the rising 200-day ($204.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($206.79), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月6日上涨 2.8%，收于 $186.64，盘中区间 $185.22–194.90，成交量约为 20 日均量的 1.6 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$195.4）、10 日（$204.5）、30 日（$218.5）和 100 日均线（$214.0）以及上行的 200 日均线（$204.7）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$206.79），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The open above $190 reached $194.90 at the May 4 low and 5-day, then faded to close back under $189.8–191.1; nothing was reclaimed. Resistance is $189.8–191.1 (June–July lows), then $194.7–196.3 (May 4 low, 5-day, Nov 5 high) and $198–200.1. Support is $181.5 (Nov 5 low), then $179.2–179.9 (Feb–Mar lows) and $176.8–177.6. A close above $191.1 would target $195–196; below $179.2, $177.
